text: 10 OVERDOSAGE In patients who received an overdosage of IXEMPRA of up to 100 mg/m 2 (approximately 2.5 times the recommended dosage), peripheral neuropathy, fatigue, musculoskeletal pain/myalgia, and gastrointestinal symptoms (nausea, anorexia, diarrhea, abdominal pain, stomatitis) occurred. There is no known antidote for overdosage of IXEMPRA. In case of overdosage, closely monitor patients for adverse reactions and provide supportive treatment as clinically indicated.
